journey.title: First run: from an empty host to an applied, verified install
journey.purpose: The primary journey. A new operator selects capabilities, provisions what they need, consents to host changes, applies, and reaches a green readiness report without editing a file.

steps.intent: Find and select the capabilities this install should run, and see what each pulls in.
Review the trusted base, choose the supervision seed, and inspect its full declared closure before confirmation.
steps.via: seed toggles, closure preview, then confirmation

steps.intent: Confirm the derived resource set and add an optional resource.
Provision each required credential, using the card's purpose text and obtain link.
Acknowledge that integration binding is deferred.
Consent to the required tools and one medium-risk safeguard after reading its risk and privilege.
Review the plan, confirm, and read the per-item result.
Confirm every required item is ready.

claims.statement: The operator reaches an applied, verified install without opening a JSON file at any point.
claims.rationale: The whole point of the wizard. Verified by observing the recorded run, not by a DOM assertion.

claims.statement: At every step, the consequence of a choice is visible before the operator moves past it.
